integrity: The primary full text was inspected at Appendix B, including the separated stability operator, parity conditions, quadratic form, even-sector exclusion, odd-sector ground-state reduction, general bound, and the exact k=1 and k=2 calculations. The new sign threshold is proved symbolically using an explicit negative-energy test at frequency 2k-1 and a positive zero-mode plus ground-state transform at frequency 2k+1. The bundled symbolic checker independently verifies the two identities and the rotational Jacobi decomposition.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for the Dirichlet stability problem of the generalized Lawson bands bar tau_{1,2k}. It does not compute the full closed-surface index of all Lawson tau-surfaces or the indices of general twisted Lawson surfaces. It relies on the source's proved Sturm-Liouville reduction and its lemma that only the radial ground state of an admissible odd Fourier sector can contribute at nonpositive energy.
title: Exact Dirichlet index of every generalized Lawson band
